description: This file defines the EntityDisplayModeListBuilder class for building and rendering a list of entity view mode entities within Drupal's field_ui module, including methods for constructing headers, rows, operations, loading entities, and rendering tables with AJAX dialog support.

classes.name: EntityDisplayModeListBuilder
classes.description: A class to build and render a list of entity display mode entities, with support for AJAX dialogs and entity filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the list builder with entity type, storage, and all entity types, overriding the default limit to display all view modes.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the list builder using the container to get entity type manager and definitions.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the entity list table with 'Name' and 'Description' columns.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a table row for a given entity, including label and description.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Retrieves operations for an entity, modifying the 'edit' operation to open in a modal dialog with AJAX.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads entities and groups them by their target type.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the list of entities as tables grouped by entity type, with add new links opening in modal dialogs.

methods.name: isValidEntity
methods.description: Checks if an entity type has a valid view builder handler and route for display.
